subject.title: fix(sessions): keep Matrix DM session keys case-distinct per peer

question: Should OpenClaw land the channel-bearing Matrix DM mitigation while `per-peer` intentionally remains case-folded and the canonical cross-peer transcript-isolation report stays open?
rationale: The patch is deliberately scoped to persisted keys that contain a channel; changing `per-peer` would require a broader compatibility and session-key contract decision, but leaving it folded retains a documented cross-principal isolation gap on permissive Matrix homeservers.

options.title: Land the bounded mitigation
options.body: Merge the channel-bearing scope repair, retain the explicit `per-peer` warning, and keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/102313 open for the broader key-contract decision.

options.title: Require a complete scope decision first
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers choose and validate a compatibility-safe way for channel-agnostic `per-peer` keys to isolate case-distinct principals.

recommendation.title: Land the bounded mitigation
recommendation.body: Merge the channel-bearing scope repair, retain the explicit `per-peer` warning, and keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/102313 open for the broader key-contract decision.
